quote.text: The one wants a friend for his own advantage; the other wants to make himself an advantage to his friend.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that true parenting involves giving without expecting a return—nurturing your child’s growth, just as you learn and evolve through the experience.
    • Strive to be an advantage to your child by modeling virtues such as empathy and selflessness, fostering a relationship of mutual support rather than one driven by self-interest.
  • Leadership
    • Effective leadership is built on the principle of servant leadership; a true leader enriches others by elevating their strengths, ensuring the team’s success is a shared endeavor.
    • Embrace the idea that when you invest in others, supporting their growth and well-being, you create an environment where every member can flourish, ultimately reflecting back on your own leadership.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, success arises when you focus on delivering genuine value for all stakeholders, fostering relationships based on trust and mutual benefit rather than opportunism.
    • Develop products and strategies that enhance the capabilities of your team and delight your customers, ensuring that every decision is driven by a commitment to collective advancement rather than individual gain.
